_about: Demo scenario for Relay. `./scripts/seed-demo.sh` plays it through the real pipeline (Gemini summaries, task matching, blockers, outcome questions). Edit freely: people must exist in the seed (backend/app/seed.py); sessions are what relay-agent would send.

sessions.title: Weekly revenue rollup for Finance
transcript: user: Build a weekly revenue rollup on top of fct_revenue for the Finance close dashboard
assistant: Created models/fct_revenue_weekly.sql grouping fct_revenue by ISO week, plus not-null and uniqueness tests on week_start.
user: The refunds column should come from the refunds table, can you join it?
assistant: I can't read the finance.refunds table: permission denied for schema finance. The join is written but can't run until someone grants SELECT on finance.refunds to the analytics role.
user: ok, I've asked Meera from Finance for access. Leave it there for now.
assistant: Done for now. Next: run the model once access is granted and compare totals with Finance's sheet.

sessions.title: Schema change guard for orders_daily
transcript: user: Add a check that runs before orders_daily and stops it if raw.orders columns changed. Done means: the pipeline stops before building models and posts a clear message naming the column that changed.
agent: Added pipelines/checks/schema_guard.sql that compares information_schema.columns for raw.orders with a stored snapshot.
agent: Wired the guard as the first step of orders_daily; it fails with 'raw.orders: column amount renamed to net_amount' when the snapshot differs.
agent: Task summary: guard implemented and tested against a renamed column; snapshot refresh is a manual step for now.

sessions.title: Data quality checks for fct_revenue
transcript: user: Add data quality checks to fct_revenue: row counts and nulls before the dashboard refresh
assistant: Added not-null tests on day and revenue, and a row-count check that fails if a day has fewer than 50 orders.
user: Run them
assistant: All checks pass on the last 30 days. They now run before the 11:00 dashboard refresh. Ready for review.

sessions.title: Review PR #38 dedupe customers
transcript: user: Review PR #38: dedupe customers in stg_customers
assistant: The dedupe keeps the latest record per email. Two issues: it lowercases emails after the dedupe instead of before, and there is no test for customers with no email.
user: Leave those as review comments
assistant: Added both comments to PR #38 and marked it 'changes requested'.

sessions.title: Automate SSO accounts for new joiners
transcript: user: Automate creating email and SSO accounts when HR marks a joiner as hired
agent: Wrote a script that reads the HR onboarding sheet and creates the Google Workspace account.
agent: The Okta step fails: the service account needs the 'User Administrator' role, which only an Okta super admin can grant.
user: Kavya is the Okta super admin, I've asked her. Pause here.
agent: Paused. Next: once the role is granted, run the script against the next joiner and confirm SSO login works.
